detail: a towering figure with matte slate-grey skin stepping half-submerged into an unbroken vertical face of raw granite, the solid rock parting around their shoulders like drifting mountain fog without cracking or disturbing a single pebble

evidence.quote: These are tall beings with slate grey skin. They have been seen to walk into mountains and disappear as easily as people walk into the fog.

facts.extent: 2.6 meters tall figure at a sheer mountain cliff face
facts.scale_ref: a full head and shoulders taller than an ordinary human; sheer stone wall rising behind them
facts.material: weathered slate-grey epidermis, unquarried mountain granite, low-hanging mist
facts.state: half-merged with solid stone in silent, frictionless transit

note: The Grey Wind pass through solid geological strata as effortlessly as mortals walk into mist, leaving no tunnel or fracture behind.
